note: One row per requirement in the project brief, with the gate that blocks it and the number that would clear it. Status vocabulary: done | partial | blocked | registered (design frozen, data pending) | rejected (documented rejection). A 'done' row means the deliverable exists in the repo with its own verification; it does not mean an unverified number was filled in. Every row carries either an official source link, a provenance link to the page documenting derivation, or an explicit UNVERIFIED/blocked badge.
